To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a desirable combination of xanthan gum and wheat germ protein isolate, with low egg yolk can be applied to produce low cholesterol mayonnaises with comparable properties with the conventional mayonnaises.
the mixture of wheat germ protein isolate and xanthan gums could be used as a good emulsifier in low cholesterol mayonnaaise formulation.
a desirable combination of XG, WGPI and egg yolk can be used to produce a mayonnaise with comparable stability, textural, rheological, and sensory properties to the conventional mayonnaises.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel approach to prepare a low cholesterol mayonnaises, with improved functional and sensory characteristics.
the development of a new formulation of low cholesterol mayonnaises using WGPI and XGs as emulsifying agent.
the development of low cholesterol mayonnaises using WGPI as a partial replacement for egg yolk and XG.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the combination of WGPI with XG and egg yolks can be used as a functional ingredient in the preparation of low cholesterol mayonnaises.
the combination of WGPI and xanthan can replace egg yolk in mayonnaise and the mixture proportion of 7.87, 0.2 and 0.87 % for WGPI, X and E, respectively, can produce the best mayonnaise.
the application of mixture design approach in the preparation of low cholesterol mayonnaises is a promising and effective method to optimize the product properties.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the mixture of WGPI, with egg yolk and XG, can be used as an alternative emulsifier in low cholesterol mayonnaaise.
the application of WGPI in the mayonnaise production can be considered as a new strategy to improve its nutritional and health value, as well as to decrease cholesterol content of the mayonnaise.
the application of WGPI and xanthan in the preparation of low cholesterol mayonnaises can be a promising approach for the development of healthy food products with desirable properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mixture design method can be successfully used for optimizing the mixture proportion of mayonnaise containing WGPI, XGs and egg yolk.
the combination of WGPI and xanthan can be used as an egg yolk substitute in low cholesterol mayonnaises.
the use of a combination of WGPI and xanthan in low cholesterol mayonnaises can be a promising alternative to the traditional mayonnaise, and can be used as a functional food for consumers.
